THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the lands described below is needed for apublic purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotments of land extent of about 0.4957 Hectares depictedin the Advance Tracing No. MR/MLM/2017/133 and dated03.05.2017 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Villageof Malimbada in Weligam Koralaya South Minor Division, inMalimbada Divisional Secretariat Division in Matara District inSouthern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Nakandagodahena – Extent: About 0.4957HectareNorth: Cement Channel; East: Nakandagodahena claimed byNational Water Supply and Drainage Board; South and West:Nakandagodahena claimed by V. S. Kumarage.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/9/2016/WS/519.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,‘‘Mihikatha Medura’’No. 1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.08th January, 2018.
